sentences.en: TAMMY: You know when you went to the Shetland Islands last year, Paul? Did you go by ferry or did you fly?
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 保罗，你知道去年你去设得兰群岛的时候吗？你是坐渡轮去的，还是坐飞机去的？

sentences.en: PAUL: We went by ferry, Tammy. I prefer driving to flying - the journey feels like part of the holiday
sentences.zh: PAUL: 我们坐的是渡轮，塔米。比起坐飞机，我更喜欢自己开车——旅途本身就像是假期的一部分。

sentences.en: TAMMY: Mmm. Which ferry company did you use?
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 嗯。你们用的是哪家渡轮公司？

sentences.en: PAUL: There's only one - it's called Northern Ferries. The ferries all leave from Aberdeen
sentences.zh: PAUL: 只有一家，叫北方渡轮公司（Northern Ferries）。所有渡轮都从阿伯丁出发。

sentences.en: TAMMY: How frequent are they?
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 渡轮班次有多频繁？

sentences.en: PAUL: The service is pretty limited - there's only one ferry leaving every evening in summer anyway, seven days a week - I'm not sure about the winter months
sentences.zh: PAUL: 这项服务相当有限——夏天每周七天，每天只有一班晚间渡轮；至于冬季班次，我就不清楚了。

sentences.en: TAMMY: They may only run on four or five days then
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 那么冬季可能一周只运行四到五天。

sentences.en: PAUL: OK. So it's an overnight trip. I quite like that idea. Leaving at night and waking up as you arrive on the island. Can you remember how much you paid for your tickets?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 好的。所以这是一趟过夜行程。我很喜欢这个想法：晚上出发，抵达岛屿时正好醒来。你还记得你们船票花了多少钱吗？

sentences.en: TAMMY: They were really cheap and four people and a car worked out at just under £250
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 票价非常便宜，四个人加一辆车总共不到250英镑。

sentences.en: PAUL: Really? I was expecting it to be more like £400 during the peak season
sentences.zh: PAUL: 真的吗？我原本以为旺季期间要接近400英镑呢。

sentences.en: TAMMY: So was I. It's great value. It's a good idea to book in advance because I think they get booked up quite quickly - especially during the school holidays
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 我也是这么想的。性价比很高。提前预订是个好主意，因为我觉得船票很快就会售罄——尤其是学校放假期间。

sentences.en: PAUL: Yes, I suppose so. I'm just not 100% sure of our plans yet. What if I had to cancel?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 是啊，我想也是。不过我们目前还没完全确定行程。万一我需要取消怎么办？

sentences.en: TAMMY: That could be a problem. I don't think it's their policy to give refunds - just a voucher - which you can use at a later date. But you have to cancel a month in advance to get that
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 那可能会是个问题。据我所知，他们并不提供退款，只发代金券——日后可使用。但必须提前一个月取消才能拿到代金券。

sentences.en: PAUL: Right. Well we need to make up our minds quickly then
sentences.zh: PAUL: 明白了。那我们得尽快做决定了。

sentences.en: TAMMY: You'd want to book a cabin too. We booked too late to get a cabin with a window. They're more expensive but much nicer than the inner cabins. You don't have to book a cabin at all but I think it's worth paying for. They also have luxury cabins, which are only for two people and have a TV - but I wouldn't bother with those
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 你们还得预订客舱。我们订得太晚，没能订到带窗户的客舱。这类客舱价格更高，但比内舱舒适得多。虽然不订客舱也可以，但我认为值得多花点钱。他们还有豪华客舱，仅限两人入住，并配有电视——不过我觉得没必要选那种。

sentences.en: PAUL: No, I agree
sentences.zh: PAUL: 对，我也这么认为。

sentences.en: TAMMY: The only other thing I can think of is to make sure you bring snacks for the kids
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 我能想到的另一件事，就是务必给孩子们带上零食。

sentences.en: PAUL: The selection on board is quite limited and not that healthy either
sentences.zh: PAUL: 船上的食品选择很有限，而且也不太健康。

sentences.en: TAMMY: Mmm. What about wifi on board? Is that any good?
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 嗯。船上提供Wi-Fi吗？信号怎么样？

sentences.en: PAUL: Not really. So it's best to bring some books for them
sentences.zh: PAUL: 实际上不太好。所以最好给他们带几本书。

sentences.en: TAMMY: OK. We may need to bring the dog if I can't get anyone to look after him
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 好的。如果我找不到人照看狗狗，我们可能得把它带上。

sentences.en: PAUL: We brought ours and it was fine. The kennels on board are OK - they're quite big - you just need to provide a blanket
sentences.zh: PAUL: 我们带了自家的狗，一切都很顺利。船上的犬舍条件不错——空间相当宽敞——你只需自备一条毯子即可。

sentences.en: TAMMY: Uhuh. Sounds good
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 嗯嗯，听起来不错。

sentences.en: PAUL: It was all very easy really - and it was quite an adventure for the kids. They loved being on the sea at night and in the morning keeping a lookout for dolphins - we saw loads
sentences.zh: PAUL: 整个过程其实非常轻松，对孩子们来说还是一次相当有趣的冒险。他们特别喜欢夜间航行在海上，以及清晨守候观望海豚——我们看到了好多只。

sentences.en: TAMMY: OS Oh, the kids would love that!
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 哦，孩子们一定会喜欢这个！

sentences.en: PAUL: One other thing. We arrived in Aberdeen hours before the ferry was due to leave so we decided to go somewhere else rather than hang around at the port for so long
sentences.zh: PAUL: 还有一件事：我们抵达阿伯丁的时间比渡轮预定出发时间早了好几个小时，于是决定去别处逛逛，而不是在港口长时间干等。

sentences.en: TAMMY: Where did you go?
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 你们去了哪儿？

sentences.en: PAUL: Drum Castle
sentences.zh: PAUL: 德鲁姆城堡（Drum Castle）。

sentences.en: TAMMY: I've never heard of it. Is that spelt like the instrument?
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 我从来没听说过这个地方。拼写跟乐器‘鼓’（drum）一样吗？

sentences.en: PAUL: Yeah. It's really worth visiting. It's got an impressive tower and beautiful gardens and ancient woodland
sentences.zh: PAUL: 是的。它非常值得一游，拥有一座令人印象深刻的塔楼、美丽的花园以及古老的林地。

sentences.en: TAMMY: Sounds lovely. Does it have a restaurant?
sentences.zh: TAMMY: 听起来真棒。那里有餐厅吗？

sentences.en: It's only got a coffee shop - no restaurant. We looked up restaurants in the area and found an Italian one in a village nearby. I can check the name of it for you if you're interested
sentences.zh: 那里只有一家咖啡馆，没有餐厅。我们查了周边地区的餐厅，发现附近一个村庄里有家意大利餐厅。如果你感兴趣，我可以帮你确认一下它的名字。

sentences.en: Oh thanks Paul that would be
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢保罗，那太好了……
